# Pass explicit intervals to short expect.poll calls in Departure.spec

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

In GitHub Actions `Engine Tests / unit` run `44903302345` (`job 136843602084` on `#21778`), `test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs:460` failed its first attempt and passed on retry (`1 flaky`), failing the entire 3-minute `unit` job under `failOnFlakyTests` and burning an extra org CI runner slot (tracked in org Discussion `#21725`):

```text
1) [unit-engine] › test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs:420:5 › Neo.tooltip.Base — one visible tooltip per window, and a warm switch › a non-component [data-neo-tooltip] VDOM target stays across child return and hides on departure

  Error: expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality
  Expected: false
  Received: true
  Call Log:
  - Timeout 150ms exceeded while waiting on the predicate

    459 | tooltip.onDelegateMouseLeave({currentTarget: 'data-tooltip-pill', relatedTarget: {id: 'page'}});
  > 460 | await expect.poll(() => tooltip.mounted, {timeout: 150}).toBe(false);
```

Captured in `defect-note` `MESSAGE:87d6e7fb-b1fa-4c8f-a6b9-92167333457e` (`fingerprint: a1cd048b26317622`).

## The Problem

`test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs` contains five `expect.poll(..., {timeout: 150})` assertions (`lines 83, 120, 145, 417, 460`) verifying that `Neo.tooltip.Base` unmounts promptly after `retargetWindow` (`20ms`–`40ms`, with `hideDelay: null`) rather than waiting on a slow hide delay.

Playwright's `expect.poll` defaults to `intervals: [100, 250, 500, 1000]`:

1. Poll #1 runs synchronously at `t = 0ms` (immediately after `onDelegateMouseLeave` / `onMouseLeave`, before the `20ms`–`40ms` `retargetWindow` timer fires), reading `mounted === true`.
2. Playwright then sleeps **`100ms`** (`intervals[0]`).
3. Under 4-worker CI load across `8,375` unit tests, a `> 50ms` Node event-loop delay pushes wake-up past `150ms`, so `expect.poll` times out after zero or one post-timer check — even though the `20ms`–`40ms` timer already fired or is queued on the current tick.

## The Architectural Reality

- Across `test/playwright/unit/`, `Departure.spec.mjs` is the **only** spec using `{timeout: 150}` with default `[100, 250, 500, 1000]` backoff; sibling timing-sensitive unit specs pass explicit short `intervals` (e.g. `test/playwright/unit/manager/DragCoordinator.spec.mjs:1741, 1802` using `{timeout: 2000, intervals: [10, 25, 50]}`).
- Look at `Departure.spec.mjs:148-155` right alongside those tests: explicit `hideDelay` behavior is tested with `hideDelay: 200` (asserting `mounted === true` at `100ms`). Keeping the poll ceiling well below a second (e.g. `timeout: 500` with `intervals: [10, 20, 50]`, or a tiny shared helper `pollUnmounted(target)` in `Departure.spec.mjs`) actually finishes **faster** in normal runs (`~30ms`–`50ms` instead of sleeping `100ms` first) while giving `10+` post-timer polls under CI worker contention.
- Design authority: `src/tooltip/Base.mjs` `retargetWindow: 40` / `hideDelay: null` contract (`#21269` / `#21605` AC-1: *"hides the shared tooltip within `retargetWindow` (`< 300 ms`)"*) together with CI `failOnFlakyTests` enforcement in `.github/workflows/playwright.yml`.

## The Fix

In `test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs`:

1. Update all five short-timeout `expect.poll` departure assertions (`lines 83, 120, 145, 417, 460`) to pass explicit short polling intervals (`intervals: [10, 20, 50]`) and a CI-safe ceiling (`timeout: 500`, or extract a small file-local options constant / helper preserving `{message: 'no hide delay by default'}` on line 83).
2. Do **not** replace `expect.poll` with fixed `await wait(...)` sleeps (`check-fixed-sleeps.mjs` guard and `#21046` precedent), and do **not** change `src/tooltip/Base.mjs` runtime timer defaults.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All five `expect.poll` unmount assertions in `test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs` (`lines 83, 120, 145, 417, 460`) specify explicit sub-50ms `intervals` (e.g. `[10, 20, 50]`) and a CI-resilient `timeout` (`300`–`500` ms), preserving line 83's `'no hide delay by default'` message.
- [ ] `npx playwright test test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs --repeat-each=20` passes `100%` with `0` flaky attempts and passes `node ./buildScripts/util/check-fixed-sleeps.mjs`.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.tooltip.Base` (`src/tooltip/Base.mjs`) `showDelay`, `retargetWindow`, `hideDelay`, or `warmWindow` runtime defaults.
- Modifying `test/playwright/component/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs` (which already uses Playwright's full component locator assertion timeout).

## Avoided Traps

- **Using fixed `await wait(150)` instead of `expect.poll`:** Slower on unloaded machines, still races event-loop stalls, and triggers `buildScripts/util/check-fixed-sleeps.mjs`.
- **Raising `timeout` to `5000ms` without explicit `intervals`:** Keeps the unnecessary `100ms` initial sleep on every test and weakens the "hides promptly without a multi-second hideDelay" signal.
- **Running bare `npx playwright test`:** Always pass `-c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs` (or `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs`).

## Related

- Follows up `#21605` (PR `#21607`) and `#21269` (PR `#21294`).
- Supports org CI runner efficiency (`neomjs` Discussion `#21725`).
